recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-11475 follow-up is needed unless OO separately wants broader modern guidance about the Observation/Condition boundary for pregnancy status.
issue_request: FHIR-11475 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core OO change request raised against the Diagnostics module. It asked to update the common-use-case wording about recording characteristics such as pregnancy status by adding a note that the Condition resource may be used to represent these as well.
initial_application: The requested note was applied to source/diagnostics-module.html in historical commit 35a8969bf6, whose subject referenced [#11475], [#11474], [#11324], and [#12256]. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key: FHIR-11475 commit existed on the combined branch before this worker published the audit commit.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists diagnostics-module.html as the active Diagnostics page, so the inspected source is in current build scope. A later Diagnostics module rewrite in ab140a0db3 for FHIR-40540/FHIR-39168 retained the Condition note while editorially changing the surrounding phrase from subject to patient. Exact Jira phrase search found only FHIR-11475, and broader pregnancy/Condition searches did not reveal a later FHIR-core reversal. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant discussion or minutes.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current Diagnostics module Common Use Cases list already says that pregnancy-status-like patient characteristics may also be represented using Condition, preserving the substantive Jira request.
